content_of_post_to_answer: How do you maintain your focus when your muscles start to feel exhausted during a game?
answer: A lot of athletes misunderstand exhaustion as a signal to push harder mentally. In many games, focus drops not because the mind gives up, but because attention is still attached to how tired the body feels. Experienced players learn to narrow their awareness: the next pass, the next position, the next decision. Fatigue is unavoidable; losing clarity is optional. The skill is not ignoring exhaustion, but learning where to place attention when exhaustion arrives.
